final_resume.summary: Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, and full-stack development with demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable REST APIs and user interfaces. Strong problem-solver with attention to code quality and system reliability.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Designed and built a Spring Boot REST API with React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses among users. Integrated Razorpay payment gateway handling created, captured, and refunded transaction states. Authored 40 JUnit tests for API reliability and containerised the full-stack application with Docker for consistent deployment.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and removed double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to display real-time order status updates. Containerised with Docker Compose for local development and testing.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project in Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; both are heavily used in Google Cloud services.
Study distributed systems concepts (eventual consistency, sharding, replication) and apply them in a backend project; document your design decisions to demonstrate System Design thinking.
Contribute to an open-source project or create a portfolio project that showcases code review practices—write clear commit messages, request peer feedback, and document architectural decisions.
Explore Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore) in a hobby project to gain hands-on GCP experience.
Deepen your REST API design skills by studying HTTP semantics, caching strategies, and error handling; consider adding API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) to your PaySplit project.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the JD requires 1+ year of professional software development experience and familiarity with languages (Python, JavaScript, C++) and concepts (distributed systems, system design, GCP) that are not yet in your profile. Focus on gaining practical experience through internships or entry-level roles before targeting Senior Engineer positions.
